evidence.title: UC’s agreement with OpenAI prompts faculty concerns over ChatGPT
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The UC entered into a $1.2 million agreement with OpenAI for a one-year partnership which starts in December. [e004:f02] It’s an extension of a previous agreement with OpenAI, and something UC officials say has been discussed since last Spring. [e004:f03] But the final agreement surprised members of UC's Academic Senate, who raised concerns last month that they had not been sufficiently consulted. [e004:f04] University officials say they want the technology, in part, so that students and faculty have the tools they need for the 21st century. [e004:f05] They also emphasized no one has to use the technology in their classrooms. [e004:f06] But Senate leadership and teachers are worried that the agreement will encourage AI use by students in their coursework without having ethical guidelines established. evidence.title: Honda riders launch Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge with strong prologue
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Although short in distance, the prologue provided a challenging test in the hot conditions as riders tackled a sandy riverbed, dunes and frequent changes of direction, requiring complete concentration on navigation to avoid missing any of the numerous waypoints. [e001:f02] Tosha Schareina, who won the prologue at last year’s rally, was aiming to repeat that success aboard his Honda CRF450 RALLY. [e001:f03] However, he narrowly missed out on victory in the Rally GP category, finishing just one second behind championship leader Daniel Sanders. [e001:f04] Adrien Van Beveren, the 2023 Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge winner, also handled the tricky navigation well, finishing just three seconds behind his teammate in a prologue that lasted less than six minutes. [e001:f05] Although the short prologue offered only a brief taste of what lies ahead, it provided an important opportunity to assess the conditions and get into the rhythm of the rally and with both riders finishing inside the top ten, they will have the opportunity to choose their starting positions for stage one, a decision that could prove crucial as the rally gets underway. [e001:f06] With a further 1,883km of riding ahead this week, tomorrow’s opening full stage will take competitors away from Al Ain to the rally’s new location of Madinat Zayed. [e001:f07] The stage will cover a total distance of 344km, including 227km against the clock, as the riders begin their journey into the demanding desert terrain. [e001:f08] Finishing second and third puts them in strong positions for tomorrow, so let’s see how things unfold. [e001:f09] Tomorrow’s stage is a fast one to Madinat Zayed, ahead of the marathon stages on stages two and three. [e001:f10] Adrien Van Beveren 42 Monster Energy Honda HRC The prologue went well, I pushed hard and gave it my best. [e001:f11] It was challenging because we had so many small waypoints - those WPPs that you have to validate within 20 metres. [e001:f12] Tosha Schareina 68 Monster Energy Honda HRC I'm happy to be back here in the desert for the prologue. [e001:f13] It was quite a strange prologue with so many changes of line and direction, which made it challenging. [e001:f14] I finished third overall, just one second behind second place, so it was really close! [e001:f15] Rally GP Result - Prologue Pos. evidence.title: 首位交代35回。「F1史上最もカオス」な一戦をフェルスタッペンが0.639秒差で制す / F1ラスベガスGP 2026《決勝》結果と詳報
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 0.639秒差の2位にランド・ノリス、1.529秒差の3位にオスカー・ピアストリが続き、マクラーレンが今シーズン初のダブル表彰台を獲得した。 [e001:f02] 17番グリッドから追い上げたピアストリにとっても今季初の表彰台となった。 [e001:f03] オーバーテイク数は352回、首位が入れ替わったのは実に35回。 [e001:f04] 12周を終えても上位10台が9秒以内にひしめき、最終的にも6位までが7.955秒以内に収まった。 [e001:f05] ノリスは「F1史上最もカオスなレースだったと思う。 [e001:f06] ランド・ノリス（マクラーレン）とマックス・フェルスタッペン（レッドブル）とオスカー・ピアストリ（マクラーレン）、2026年11月21日（土） F1ラスベガスGP 決勝（ラスベガス市街地コース） Courtesy Of McLaren 2026年11月21日（土） F1ラスベガスGP 決勝（ラスベガス市街地コース） Courtesy Of Pirelli & C. [e001:f07] ただ、同じ周の最終コーナーで抜き返すと、4周目にはアイザック・ハジャーがラッセルをかわし、レッドブルが1-2体制を築いた。 [e001:f08] F1でこんな光景は見たことがない」 残り3周、表彰台を争っていたラッセルはターン5への進入でタイヤをロックさせ、バリアに接触して9番手に後退。 [e001:f09] 6番グリッドからミディアムでスタートしたチームメイトのアンドレア・キミ・アントネッリは、終盤にフェルスタッペンと首位を争ったものの、 アクセル操作を誤った結果としてエネルギー制御システムが狂って失速 。 [e001:f10] オスカー・ピアストリ（マクラーレン MCL40）とランド・ノリス（マクラーレン MCL40）とフランコ・コラピント（アルピーヌ A526）、2026年11月21日（土） F1ラスベガスGP 決勝（ラスベガス市街地コース） Courtesy Of McLaren 波乱続出、ハジャーはウイング脱落で後退 波乱はスタート前から始まっていた。 [e001:f11] ローソンは周回遅れの解消を許されて首位と同一周回に戻り、最終周に1分35秒591のファステストラップを記録して15位でフィニッシュした。 [e001:f12] チームメイトのフランコ・コラピントが6位に続き、アルピーヌは2台で18ポイントを獲得した。 [e001:f13] カルロス・サインツ（ウィリアムズ）は20番グリッドから1周目だけで9つ順位を上げて11番手に浮上し、8位でフィニッシュした。 [e001:f14] カマラは対照的に、1周目に全ドライバーで最多となる3つのポジションを失い、18番手に後退。 [e001:f15] アロンソ最終周にリタイヤ、アストン無得点 アストンマーティン・ホンダ勢は1周目に揃って順位を上げ、フェルナンド・アロンソが17番手、ランス・ストロールが19番手に浮上した。 [e001:f16] レース結果 F1 F1ラスベガスGP googlePreferred Google優先ソースに追加 installDesktop ホーム画面に追加 notifications 更新通知を受け取る notifications 更新通知を解除する。

evidence.body: [e002:f01] In a race that never settled down into any particular race order, the likes of Lando Norris , Oscar Piastri, Kimi Antonelli, George Russell , Isack Hadjar and even Alpine's Pierre Gasly all spent time in the top three before ultimately it was the McLaren drivers led by the 2025 world champion following Verstappen onto the podium. [e002:f03] Article continues under video Lewis Hamilton battled back from a 10-second penalty to finish seventh, with Carlos Sainz pipping Russell on the line to finish eighth. [e002:f04] Having finished seventh on the road, a 10-second penalty for a clumsy tap on his team-mate Hamilton meant Charles Leclerc was demoted to the final points paying position in 10th. [e002:f05] There was also a late penalty handed out to Hadjar, who was penalised for driving too slowly under the safety car , although this had no major impact on his result dropping him one place below Liam Lawson's Racing Bull to finish 15th. [e002:f10] In a similar vane, despite not being in the title battle for the entire season, Verstappen can also secure runner-up in the championship for the second season running. evidence.title: FIA announces grid penalty for Las Vegas Grand Prix collision
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The FIA stewards have decided upon a five-place grid penalty for Sergio Perez for causing a collision with Haas ’ Rafael Camara at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. [e004:f02] The Cadillac driver attempted a move into Turn 14, but tagged the rear of the rookie’s car and sent him into a spin, bringing out the Safety Car. [e004:f03] FIA stewards confirm Sergio Perez grid penalty Perez had been catching Camara along the Las Vegas Strip Straight, and moved to the inside ahead of the left-right-left sequence of Turns 14-16, but made contact with the Brazilian while doing so. [e004:f04] While a 10-second time penalty would normally have been the punishment for such a moment, because Perez retired from the race as a result of the collision, that has been converted to a five-place grid penalty for the Qatar Grand Prix instead. [e004:f05] “The Stewards noted that at no point during the manoeuvre was the front axle of Car 11 [Perez] at least alongside the mirror of Car 51 [Camara],” the verdict explained. [e004:f06] “The two cars collided at the entry to Turn 14, resulting in Car 11 retiring from the Race. [e004:f07] Applying the Driving Standards Guidelines, the Stewards determined that Car 11 had not earned the right to the corner and was wholly to blame for the collision.” Perez attributed some of the blame to the overtake mode capabilities placed on the 2026 cars, with the slipstream effect exaggerated to its fullest extent at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. [e004:f08] With that, he did not think Camara would have seen him coming or been expecting a move, because of how far behind Perez was heading onto the Strip. [e004:f09] More from the Las Vegas Grand Prix Max Verstappen survives Mercedes onslaught in spectacular Las Vegas Grand Prix thriller Max Verstappen pokes fun at George Russell in Las Vegas GP team radio “It’s this overtake mode, it’s so artificial that basically I exited Turn 12 a second away from Camara, so Camara thought he was completely safe, but then into Turn 14 I was alongside him,” the Cadillac driver explained. [e004:f10] “But, when I saw that he was doing a normal line, I tried to avoid him, and it was just too late.” Camara admitted he thought his race was done as a result of being spun around, though he eventually recovered onto the road to take 16th place at the line. [e004:f11] “I thought it was over there,” he said. [e004:f12] “I don’t know how it didn’t damage anything because we came back and it was all right. [e004:f13] We just had to change tyres and came back into it. [e004:f14] “I think I was quite surprised with that, and after that we had some fun in the restart, and then after was just a bit more boring being alone.” Read next: Lewis Hamilton fumes at Las Vegas penalty as Charles Leclerc comparison emerges。

evidence.title: Archer announces multi-year air taxi partnership with Formula 1
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The partners plan to explore dedicated air taxi pick-up and drop-off locations at circuits and the inclusion of air taxi services within Formula 1’s hospitality and ticketing offerings. [e003:f02] As Archer’s commercial operations come online in F1 markets, the aim is to offer fans an alternative to ground traffic between major airports, business hubs and Grand Prix venues. [e003:f03] Archer’s planned US air taxi networks align closely with Formula 1 race locations, including Miami and Texas where the company has unveiled infrastructure plans. [e003:f04] Internationally, Archer’s commercial rollout across the Middle East, Asia and Europe provides a foundation for service in additional race cities. [e003:f05] “With 830 million fans worldwide, Formula 1 gives us a global audience of prospective passengers who are as obsessed with high-performance vehicles as we are,” said Adam Goldstein, founder and CEO of Archer. evidence.title: ナイキ、キャデラックF1と提携交渉か ウォルフ代表はメルセデスを去ったスポンサーに皮肉（TopNews）
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 一方、メルセデスF1のトト・ウォルフ代表は、ルイス・ハミルトンの移籍を機にチームを離れたスポンサーに皮肉を向けた。 [e006:f02] ●【F1ライブ結果速報】F1ラスベガスGPも全セッションライブでお届け ドイツ紙『Bild（ビルト）』によると、ナイキとキャデラックは以前から提携に向けて協議を続けている。 [e006:f03] 交渉が加速したのは、グレアム・ロードンがチーム代表を務めていた時期だという。 [e006:f04] 同紙によると、アメリカのスポーツ用品大手ナイキはマイアミGPでキャデラックの首脳陣に特製シューズも提供し、双方は今も契約に関心を示しているという。 [e006:f05] キャデラックは現在、トミー・ヒルフィガーのウェアを使用している。 [e006:f06] ■ハミルトン移籍でメルセデスへの関心後退 『Bild（ビルト）』によると、ナイキはかつて、ハミルトンの世界的な知名度を主な理由としてメルセデスとの提携も検討した。 [e006:f07] だが、7度のF1王者ハミルトンが2025年にフェラーリへ移籍すると、関心は薄れたとされる。 [e006:f08] メルセデスはプーマとの長年の提携を終え、2025年からアディダスと契約している。 [e006:f09] ■ウォルフ代表、ハミルトン移籍で離れたスポンサーを振り返る ウォルフ代表はラスベガスでドイツのテレビ局『RTL』と同国の放送局『Sky Sport』の共同インタビューに応じ、ハミルトンの後任にアンドレア・キミ・アントネッリを起用した当時を振り返った。 [e006:f10] ハミルトンが去ったことを理由に、一部のスポンサーもチームを離れたという。 [e006:f11] 「スポンサーから『キミ・アントネッリとは誰なのか』と聞かれ、ルイス・ハミルトンがいなくなったから私たちと一緒に歩んでいくつもりはないと言われたことを、はっきり覚えています。 [e006:f12] 彼らの判断が間違っていたのは明らかですから、その点ではいくらか満足しています。 [e006:f13] 」 アントネッリが2026年のF1王者となった今、ウォルフ代表はこう付け加えた。 [e006:f14] 」 ■2027年からF1公式パートナー ナイキは2027年からF1の公式パートナーとなり、世界各地のF1イベントでスタッフが着用する公式ユニフォームを供給する。 [e006:f15] 提携にはファン向けの商品展開も含まれる。 [e006:f16] また、ナイキは女性ドライバーの育成を目的とするF1アカデミーの公式パートナーにも就任する。

evidence.title: Cadillac and Audi join Hot Wheels' expanding F1 collection
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Mattel, the owner of the Hot Wheels brand, has announced new premium die-cast models of the two newest additions to the F1 grid. [e001:f02] The announcement marks the first time Cadillac and Audi F1 teams have been included in the Hot Wheels F1 collection, with both brands set to feature cars carrying their respective 2026 liveries. [e001:f03] Cadillac's first model will feature Sergio Perez's #11 car, arriving in February 2027, with Valtteri Bottas's #77 machine following later in the year. [e001:f04] Audi's initial release will feature Gabriel Bortoleto's #5 car, also scheduled for February 2027, followed later in the year by Nico Hulkenberg's #27. [e001:f05] The models feature metal bodies and chassis, 'Real Riders' tyres, display plinths and specialist collector packaging. [e001:f06] Each will be priced at £11.99 in the UK and available through mass retailers and Mattel Creations. [e001:f07] The remaining nine teams will also receive updated 2026-liveried models throughout 2027, completing a 22-car collection featuring both drivers from every team. [e001:f08] Alongside the premium die-cast releases, Hot Wheels is expanding its wider F1 offering with new track sets and a Tooned collection. [e001:f09] The Hot Wheels Racing F1 Elimination Race track set is scheduled to launch in spring 2027, bringing head-to-head racing to the range. [e001:f10] The wider track set collection will be priced between £29.99 and £149.99. [e001:f11] A new Silver Series Tooned F1 collection will also arrive throughout 2027, featuring all 11 teams in an exaggerated Hot Wheels design. [e001:f12] The 1:64-scale models will include authentic team logos, sponsorship details, front and rear wing decoration, and driver-specific helmet colours. [e001:f13] Each will retail for £4.49. [e001:f14] The expansion builds on the ongoing commercial partnership between F1 and Mattel, which has increasingly sought to connect the championship with younger audiences and collectors through toys, merchandise and interactive fan experiences at grands prix. [e001:f15] Alex Ries, Mattel's vice president and global head of Hot Wheels, said: "Our relationship with F1 continues to grow, creating new opportunities for Hot Wheels to bring the excitement of the sport to fans and collectors around the world." Ries added: "Hot Wheels wants as many F1 fans as possible to be able to celebrate the teams and drivers they love, and completing the 2026 grid with the addition of Cadillac and Audi brings us closer to that goal." evidence.title: Ferrari boss signals doubt over ‘unmanageable’ Lewis Hamilton-Leclerc line-up
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The two Ferrari drivers came to blows on Lap 38 of the race when Leclerc’s attempted move down the inside of his teammate into Turn 7 ended in wheel-to-wheel contact that pitched Hamilton into a spin, an incident that capped off what had already been a tumultuous weekend for the Maranello-based squad at the Las Vegas Strip Circuit. [e002:f02] Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton under scrutiny after latest clash The collision comes only two weeks after Vasseur held behind-closed-doors talks with both men to clear the air over the first-lap squabble that cost the team a win in Mexico. [e002:f03] Vasseur, in particular, pointed the finger at Leclerc, whom he spoke with privately prior to conducting his post-race media duties , citing that the Monegasque had gone against a team order not to try and overtake his teammate at that stage in proceedings. [e002:f04] “First of all, I must say that what happened is unacceptable,” Vasseur expressed to Sky Italy. [e002:f05] “I’ll repeat the same message I gave in Mexico, because we need to think of the people working at Maranello, the team, all the shareholders and the sponsors. [e002:f06] “We had told Charles not to overtake, because at that stage it was important to catch up with the cars ahead rather than get caught up in a battle. [e002:f07] “To be honest, I’m more than just angry, because the message was clear after Mexico and we’d all had a chat together in Brazil. [e002:f08] Today we gave an instruction with the team’s best interests in mind, yet they were racing against each other: the result is what we saw. [e002:f09] And it’s extremely frustrating for all of us.” Unlike in Mexico City – where he emphasised that Ferrari had failed as a collective – Vasseur insisted that no blame can be apportioned to the team for this latest run-in. [e002:f10] We’d been very open and very clear after Mexico, and we were the same today.” More on the Ferrari collision in Las Vegas Telemetry reveals full Ferrari impact of Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas Ferrari outlines action after ‘unacceptable’ Hamilton, Leclerc clash in Las Vegas Having divulged that the coming together would trigger another internal discussion in the coming week, Vasseur hasn’t ruled out action being taken against either driver. [e002:f11] Perhaps it’s also time to start thinking about next season.” Amid Max Verstappen’s claim that having two well-matched drivers in the same team isn’t conducive to success, Vasseur had insisted in Brazil that he continues to back his decision to pair Hamilton with Leclerc, arguing that the intense competition between the two has been integral to Ferrari sitting second in the Constructors’ Championship. [e002:f12] But for the first time, Vasseur appears to have signalled doubts about the suitability of the Hamilton and Leclerc line-up, as he admitted the various on-track disputes that the two have been embroiled in this year have dented their working relationship. [e002:f13] Pressed on whether he expected things to come to this when he made the decision to replace Carlos Sainz with seven-time champion Hamilton from 2025, the Frenchman responded: “Honestly, no. [e002:f14] But honestly, ultimately, it’s a human misunderstanding between them, not with the team.” Read next: Max Verstappen delivers brutal verdict on George Russell after Las Vegas showdown Ferrari Charles Leclerc Fred Vasseur Lewis Hamilton Related Articles Taylor Powling 24 Nov 2026 Lewis Hamilton reignites Charles Leclerc criticism after Las Vegas clash Lewis Hamilton appeared to take issue with Charles Leclerc again after their collision in Las Vegas. evidence.title: FIA Confirms Unanimous 2030 Power Unit Framework Agreement and Full-Time Stewards From 2027
evidence.body: [e003:f01] [Image 1: image](https:// ## FIA Announces Two Major Governance Decisions in November 2026 The FIA has confirmed unanimous agreement among key stakeholders on the 2030 power unit technical framework for Formula 1, while separately announcing that full-time stewards will be introduced from the **2027 season** onwards. [e003:f02] Both decisions were announced in **November 2026**. [e003:f03] The 2030 power unit framework secures a long-range technical direction for F1, with the FIA and participating teams having committed to its terms without reported opposition. [e003:f04] The recruitment process for full-time stewards is now underway. ## 2030 Power Unit Framework The FIA confirmed that all key parties — including the FIA itself and F1 teams — reached unanimous agreement on the 2030 power unit technical framework. [e003:f05] No dissenting positions from stakeholders were reported at the time of the announcement. [e003:f06] The framework sets the technical specifications that will govern Formula 1 power units from 2030, providing manufacturers and teams with a defined long-term planning horizon. ## Full-Time Stewards From the 2027 Season Alongside the power unit announcement, the FIA confirmed it is **beginning recruitment of full-time stewards** ahead of the 2027 Formula 1 season. [e003:f07] The stated purpose of the initiative is to bring greater levels of consistency to race management and officiating decisions across the championship. [e003:f08] Under the current structure, stewards have operated on a rotating, part-time basis at individual race events. [e003:f09] The move to full-time appointments represents a structural change to how the FIA administers on-track governance in F1. ## Scope of the Changes Taken together, the two announcements reflect a direction from the FIA toward greater standardization and long-term planning in Formula 1 governance. [e003:f10] The 2030 power unit agreement addresses the sport’s technical regulations over a multi-year horizon, while the full-time steward programme targets procedural consistency within individual race weekends beginning in 2027. [e003:f11] Recruitment for the full-time steward roles was confirmed as active as of November 2026. ### Latest News ! [e003:f12] [Image 2: logo](https:// [! Anthropic IPO: Claude parent beats SpaceX on cash raised, not on market value
evidence.body: [e001:f01] International Finance decodes things in detail International Finance Business Desk 8 Min Read Anthropic has taken the record for the largest initial public offering in history from SpaceX, five months after Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company set it. [e001:f02] The Claude maker sold 980 million shares at USD 83 each on November 18, raising USD 81.3 billion before any overallotment, against the USD 75 billion SpaceX raised at the same stage in June. [e001:f03] The record it did not take is valuation. [e001:f04] Anthropic closed at USD 97.17, a market capitalisation of about USD 1.27 trillion, while SpaceX ended its debut above USD 2 trillion. [e001:f05] Anthropic marketed 825 million shares at USD 70 to USD 78, then raised both the price and the number of shares, settling at USD 83 for 980 million. [e001:f06] Before the underwriters’ overallotment option, SpaceX raised USD 75 billion and Anthropic raised USD 81.3 billion, a gap of USD 6.3 billion. [e001:f07] Anthropic also sold USD 26 billion of non-voting shares at the IPO price to Google, Nvidia, Microsoft, AMD, Broadcom, Micron and TSMC in a private placement that ran alongside the offering. [e001:f08] SpaceX had no equivalent placement, though it raised USD 25 billion in bonds in the month of its listing. [e001:f09] On the same basis as SpaceX, Anthropic priced about 38% lower. [e001:f10] Anthropic opened at USD 111.50, 34% above its offer price, which briefly put its fully diluted value near USD 2 trillion. [e001:f11] It then fell back and closed at USD 97.17, up 17%, for a market capitalisation of about USD 1.27 trillion, or about USD 1.75 trillion fully diluted. [e001:f12] Anthropic was valued at USD 965 billion in a private round in May 2026, so its fully diluted IPO value was about 55% higher. [e001:f13] SpaceX was valued at USD 1.25 trilion when it merged with xAI in February, so its IPO value was about 42% higher. [e001:f14] That figure includes xAI and the social network X, recast after the February merger. [e001:f15] Anthropic’s third-quarter revenue rose by 1,127% year on year. [e001:f16] As Anthropic’s private valuation rose, the fair value of its convertible notes, derivatives and SAFEs rose with it, and the increase was booked as a loss.

evidence.title: SpaceX Makes History With Starship Catch as Falcon 9 Launches New US Spy Satellites
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Josh Dinner/ STARBASE, Texas, - SpaceX has reached a major milestone in reusable rocket technology while maintaining a busy launch schedule, highlighting the company's expanding role in commercial spaceflight, US national security and NASA's efforts to return astronauts to the Moon. [e002:f02] The aerospace company, founded by Elon Musk, successfully brought its Starship spacecraft back from orbit on November 14, 2026, completing the first capture of a Starship upper stage by the giant mechanical arms of its launch tower in South Texas. [e002:f03] Just over a week later, SpaceX launched another Falcon 9 rocket carrying classified satellites for the US National Reconnaissance Office (NRO) on November 22. [e002:f04] Together, the missions demonstrate two sides of SpaceX's operations: its established satellite-launch business and its ambitious effort to develop a fully reusable rocket capable of supporting future missions to the Moon and Mars. [e002:f05] SpaceX Starship Completes Historic Return From Orbit Starship Flight 15 lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase facility in Texas on November 13, beginning one of the most ambitious demonstrations in the company's rocket development program. [e002:f06] During the flight, the spacecraft released 26 Starlink satellites before preparing for a carefully controlled return through Earth's atmosphere. [e002:f07] Its engines reignited during the final descent, allowing the spacecraft to rotate into a vertical position before being caught by the launch tower's mechanical arms, commonly known as "chopsticks." The maneuver marked an important achievement for SpaceX's long-term goal of recovering both stages of its Starship launch system. [e002:f08] SpaceX originally intended to recover both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship spacecraft at the launch site. [e002:f09] However, the booster experienced a problem during its return shortly after launch, preventing the planned tower catch. [e002:f10] Falcon 9 Launches US Intelligence Satellites While Starship development continues, SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket remains central to its commercial and government launch operations. [e002:f11] The booster, identified as B1097, completed its 14th flight, demonstrating the operational maturity of SpaceX's reusable Falcon system. [e002:f12] The mission also reflected the company's increasingly rapid launch operations, with another Falcon 9 mission having departed the same California facility less than two days earlier. [e002:f13] Unlike Starship, Falcon 9 currently recovers its first stage while its upper stage is generally expended after delivering spacecraft into orbit. [e002:f14] Why Starship Matters for NASA's Moon Missions Beyond satellite launches, Starship is expected to play an important role in NASA's Artemis program. [e002:f15] This capability is particularly important because Starship's lunar missions are expected to require multiple tanker launches to supply the necessary fuel. [e002:f16] SpaceX is expected to continue Falcon 9 launches while analyzing data from Starship Flight 15.

evidence.title: SpaceX Sets 32 Hour Falcon 9 Launch Turnaround Record
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Rapid launch operations at California's Vandenberg Space Force Base reached a new milestone on November 22, 2026, when SpaceX sent another Falcon 9 rocket into orbit for the U.S. [e005:f02] The mission, designated NROL-136, followed another launch from the same pad just 32 hours earlier, establishing a new turnaround rocket departed Launch Complex-4E at 4:23 a.m. local time, carrying classified satellites toward low Earth orbit. [e005:f03] According to , the interval between the two launches was precisely 32 hours, 3 minutes and 21 's previous record for consecutive launches from a single pad was 45 hours, achieved at Pad 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. [e005:f04] The latest achievement brings the company closer to its stated goal of reducing launch preparation time to 24 Dontchev, SpaceX's vice president of launch, credited the company's West Coast team for the accomplishment in a November 22 post on X."Massive high five to the @SpaceX west coast team for a world record launch to launch turn from Pad 4e last night! [e005:f05] 32 hr, 3 min, 21 sec! [e005:f06] This smashed the previous record of 45 hrs from Pad 40. [e005:f07] According to the NRO, the architecture is intended to strengthen global surveillance coverage and improve the resilience of U.S. intelligence operations in -136 represented the network's 15th dedicated deployment mission and the NRO's sixth launch of 2026. [e005:f08] SpaceX and Northrop Grumman developed the satellite architecture in partnership with the agency, which began deploying the constellation in May 2024 through the NROL-146 NRO has not disclosed how many satellites NROL-136 carried or provided details about their onboard equipment. [e005:f09] All six of its launches during 2026 have used Falcon 9 rockets to deliver classified payloads into low Earth orbit, according to rocket's first-stage booster separated approximately two minutes after liftoff before returning to Vandenberg. [e005:f10] It landed at Landing Zone 4 around seven and a half minutes after launch, completing another recovery booster, identified as B1097, completed its 14th flight. [e005:f11] Its previous assignments included NASA's Sentinel-6B ocean-monitoring satellite, NROL-172, USSF-259 and eight Starlink , SpaceX is pursuing another major development in reusable launch technology through its Starship program. [e005:f12] Ship 42, the first Starship upper stage successfully caught by the launch tower's mechanical arms, will not return to flight despite being considered technically capable of flying at the TomorrowX Summit on November 18, SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk explained that the company intends to preserve the vehicle because of its historical significance."In this case, because it's kind of an historic ship, we're going to, I think, not take any chances with the ship and just kind of leave it for public display, because what it's done is historic," Musk 42 completed Starship's 15th test flight, launched November 13, and returned to the company's Starbase facility in South Texas the following day. [e005:f13] Musk said the vehicle had performed well enough that it could potentially fly again after several weeks of recovery marked a significant step toward SpaceX's ambition of developing a fully reusable orbital transportation system. [e005:f14] Before that mission, the company had successfully caught its Super Heavy first-stage booster three times and reflown a booster twice, but had never caught a Starship upper stage."Everyone knew, within SpaceX, at least, how important this milestone was, and that it was really something fundamental and profound — that Starship will be the first-ever fully reusable orbital space system," Musk also plans to use Starship to deploy much larger satellite networks. [e005:f15] The next-generation Starlink constellation is planned to contain approximately 100,000 satellites, while the proposed Starmind AI data-center constellation is expected to be 10 times company has already begun deploying next-generation Starlink hardware. [e005:f16] Ship carried 26 of the new internet satellites during Flight 14, launched September 28, and repeated the deployment during Flight 15.

evidence.title: SpaceX Falcon 9 Smashes Vandenberg Turnaround Record on NROL-136 Launch
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Falcon 9 lifted off at 4:23 a.m. [e003:f02] PT (12:23 UTC) on November 22, 2026, just 32 hours, three minutes, and 21 seconds after the previous mission from the same pad — approximately 23 hours faster than the previous SLC-4E record, according to NASASpaceflight . [e003:f03] Source: @SpaceX — Nov 22, 2026 ▶ Watch Liftoff on X A new Vandenberg cadence The headline number here is operational, not technical. [e003:f04] Falcon 9 has flown with this basic architecture for years, but the turnaround time between two missions from the same launch pad is a direct measure of how quickly SpaceX can refurbish ground systems, reset the transporter-erector, reload propellants, and clear the range for another flight. [e003:f05] According to NASASpaceflight, the 32-hour cycle also beat SpaceX's fastest overall turnaround from SLC-40 at Cape Canaveral — the company's busiest pad — by roughly 13 hours. [e003:f06] In other words, Vandenberg, long the quieter of SpaceX's two coasts, just posted the fastest two-launch sequence from a single pad in the company's history. [e003:f07] Source: @NASASpaceflight — Nov 22, 2026 Key figures Metric Value Mission NROL-136 for the National Reconnaissance Office Launch time 4:23 a.m. [e003:f08] PT / 12:23 UTC, Nov 22, 2026 Pad SLC-4E, Vandenberg SFB Booster B1097, 14th flight Landing LZ-4 at Vandenberg (38th landing at the zone, per NASASpaceflight) SLC-4E turnaround 32h 03m 21s — ~23h faster than previous pad record vs. [e003:f09] Each launch leaves SLC-4E with a plume-scorched flame trench, propellant lines that need to be purged and recertified, and a transporter-erector that has to be returned to horizontal, cleaned, and fitted with the next stack. [e003:f10] What is public is the NRO's broader posture: the agency has been a steady customer for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy, and has publicly signaled a shift toward proliferated constellations of smaller reconnaissance satellites rather than a handful of large, exquisite platforms. [e003:f11] That architecture favors a launch provider that can push payloads to polar and sun-synchronous orbits on short notice — exactly the capability a sub-33-hour pad turnaround at Vandenberg delivers. [e003:f12] With a proliferated-architecture customer increasingly dependent on Falcon 9, watch the gap between NROL launches shrink further into 2027. [e003:f13] Updates 📌 UPDATE — November 22, 2026 The NROL-136 payload has now been identified as a batch of Starshield satellites , according to orbital analyst Jonathan McDowell ( @planet4589 ). Anthropic Gets 13 Leveraged ETFs. SpaceX Investors Already Know How This Can End.
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The Wealth Advisor Contributor November 23, 2026 Wall Street launched 13 leveraged and inverse ETFs tied to Anthropic on Monday, just two trading sessions after the artificial intelligence company's spectacular IPO. [e004:f02] The funds arrived alongside listed options, giving traders new ways to amplify bets on a stock that had already fallen roughly 20% from its opening price. [e004:f03] But the timing recalls another celebrated technology IPO earlier this year, when similar products appeared around SpaceX's market peak and subsequently delivered losses far exceeding the underlying stock's decline. [e004:f04] Anthropic's debut on November 19 attracted enormous attention, with retail investors trading more than $750 million of shares on the first day, according to Vanda Research. [e004:f05] Anthropic shares fell as low as $83.10 during their first two sessions, barely above the $83 IPO price, before attempting a recovery Monday morning. [e004:f06] Anthropic opened about 5% higher but quickly surrendered its gains while Nvidia surged roughly 30% following Jensen Huang's reinstatement as chief executive and the Nasdaq 100 climbed more than 6%. [e004:f07] The comparison with SpaceX is particularly uncomfortable because the earlier launch demonstrated how leveraged products can disappoint investors even when their predictions are correct. [e004:f08] SpaceX's leveraged ETFs began trading June 15, followed by an options debut that generated nearly 1.8 million contracts on its first day, a record according to Cboe. [e004:f09] The stock subsequently declined about 26%, but investors who bought the five double-leveraged bullish ETFs at launch suffered losses of approximately 60% to 64%. [e004:f10] Leverage Shares' 2x short SpaceX fund lost roughly 24% over the same period despite the underlying stock falling 26%, leaving traders who correctly anticipated the decline with losses instead of profits. [e004:f11] Anthropic's new funds carry expense ratios ranging from 0.71% to more than 2%, depending on the issuer and strategy. [e004:f12] Wall Street's product manufacturers have moved faster than investors have reached a consensus about the company's valuation. [e004:f13] Within days of the IPO, traders could buy Anthropic shares, purchase options, double their daily exposure or take leveraged positions against the company. [e004:f14] Its derivatives arrived just as the stock was reaching a peak, and neither bullish nor bearish leveraged investors who held on were rewarded. [e004:f15] But the arrival of 13 funds before the company has completed its third trading session reveals how rapidly Wall Street can transform a highly anticipated business into a collection of competing short-term wagers. [e004:f16] The investors trading their leveraged derivatives face a different challenge: being right about the business may not be enough to make money on the bet.
